inv1_election_safety.statement: At most one coordinator can be in Leader state in any term T

inv2_leader_completeness.statement: If log entry is committed in term T, leaders for all terms T' > T contain that entry

inv3_log_matching.statement: If two logs agree on an entry at (term, index), all prefix entries are identical

inv4_storage_node_fencing.statement: Storage nodes never accept mutations with epoch < highest_seen_epoch

inv5_manifest_monotonicity.statement: Manifest generations never regress or conflict for any object

inv6_fail_closed_quorum_loss.statement: Partitioned leaders without majority cannot advance commit index

inv7_split_brain_mutation_prevention.statement: Two distinct leaders cannot concurrently mutate storage nodes
